{{Commons category|Operations research}}
'''Operations research''', '''operational research''', or simply '''O.R.''', is the use of [[mathematical model]]s, [[statistics]] and [[algorithm]]s to aid in decision-making. It is most often used to analyze complex real-world systems, typically with the goal of improving or optimizing performance.  It is one form of [[applied mathematics]].
